programme.title: Auntie Lee's Meat Pies
programme.desc: 1992. Comedy. Director: Joseph F. Robertson. Stars Karen Black, Pat Mortia & Kristine Rose. A woman sends her four children out to lure in men, only for them to be killed and made into meat pies.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Planespotting
programme.desc: 2005. Drama. Director: Christopher Menaul. Stars Lesley Sharp, Mark Benton & Ross Boatman. A group of aircraft enthusiasts are wrongly convicted of spying during a plane spotting trip to Greece.

programme.title: Carry On Spying
programme.desc: 1964. Comedy. Directed by Gerald Thomas. Stars Kenneth Williams, Barbara Windsor & Bernard Cribbins. A British spy and his pupils are sent to track down a stolen top secret chemical formula.

programme.title: Jacktown
programme.desc: 1962. Drama. Directed by William Martin. Stars Patty McCormack, Richard Meade & Douglas Rutherford. A young delinquent who is sent to prison, unexpectedly finds love while serving his sentence.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout the second half of November.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Mrs. Ringo. Directed by Aaron Spelling. Starring Don Durant and Mark Goddard. A woman arrives in Velardi claiming to be Ringo's wife and has a marriage certificate to back up her story.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful World
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy directed by Val Guest and starring Terence Morgan, George Cole, Kathleen Harrison. Two struggling composers hit on a novel way of producing music backwards!

programme.title: Look At Life Vintage Models
programme.desc: 1963. A look at the restoration of vintage vehicles with visits to the Montagu Motor Museum at Beaulieu in the New Forest, the high speed trials at Silverstone and the famous London to Brighton run.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Long Distance Ride. 1986. Jack explains the intricacies of the universal troop saddle and, on the longest day of the year, he watches endurance riding in the New Forest.

programme.title: Dressed to Kill
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Director: Roy William. Stars Basil Rathbone, Nigel Bruce, Patricia Morison & Edmond Breon. Sherlock Holmes & Dr. Watson hunt for the elusive plates before counterfeiters acquire them.

programme.title: Churchill's Secret Army
programme.desc: Secret Sweeties. 2003. A look at the women who joined the Secret British Resistance Units and their part in the D-Day deception that fooled Hitler into thinking that the Allies would strike back.

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Sporting Life. Stars: Leo McKern, Peggy Thorpe-Bates & Roland Culver. Rumpole reluctantly agrees to defend Fiona's sister, who's accused of murder.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Eviction. 1975. Stars Paul Barber, John Kane & John Collin. With Quilley in hospital, Lynch's attitude to the squatters hardens - but is the security firm entirely blameless?

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: 1963. Western. Director: Andrew V. McLaglen. Stars John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara & Patrick Wayne. Wealthy rancher McLintock uses his power and influence to keep the peace between conflicting groups.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: 1945. Adventure. Directed by Rowland V. Lee. Stars Charles Laughton, Randolph Scott & Barbara Britton. Pirate, Captain William Kidd, tricks the king to hire him as an escort to a treasure ship.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Breed of Violence. 1960. Stars Michael Landon, Myrna Fahey & John Ericson. Dolly Kincaid welcomes the chance to leave town with a handsome stranger, unaware that he's a bank robber.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Stars Ron Randell, Robert Parker, Joan Schofield. A jealous wife plots revenge on her husband and their starlet ballerina, who she fears are having an affair.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Noel and Mike are joined by the legendary Eddy Grant! Do you remember the Welsh band The Cheatin' Hearts? And Jean Frame has been in touch after seeing herself in our film Serious Charge.

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's The Passenger
programme.desc: The Passenger Part One. 1971. Stars Peter Barkworth, Joanna Dunham & Arthur Pentelow. Businessman David Walker picks up a hitcher, and his personal and professional problems get a whole lot worse.

programme.title: Gideon's Way
programme.desc: To Catch a Tiger. Stars John Gregson, Alexander Davion & Daphne Anderson. A victim of a car accident gives a death bed statement saying a man murdered his first wife with an overdose of morphine.

programme.title: Jigsaw
programme.desc: 1962. Directed by Val Guest and starring Jack Warner. A woman is murdered and it's up to Detective Fellows to sift through the clues and solve the 'Jigsaw'. Great shots of Brighton in the 60s.

programme.title: Beneath the 12 Mile Reef
programme.desc: 1953. Adventure. Directed by Robert D. Webb. Stars Robert Wagner, Terry Moore & Gilbert Roland. Fierce competition among sponge fishermen leads to a dangerous rivalry between two families.

programme.title: The Perfect Woman (1981)
programme.desc: 1978. Two dumb aliens are sent to earth to find an earthwoman suitable to be the wife of their leader. Stars Cameron Mitchell.

programme.title: Melody Club
programme.desc: 1949. Comedy. A nitwit investigator (Terry Thomas) goes undercover in a restaurant to catch a gang of crooks.

programme.title: Look At Life Calling The Tune
programme.desc: 1960. A general look at music, the increasing popularity of classical music and the lack of composers.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The Necktie Party. 1956. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Peter Mamakos, Lorna Thayer. Ranchers are frustrated by multiple horse thefts near Wichita and blame a band of gypsies camped on Gus Cassen's property.

programme.title: The Westerner
programme.desc: Ghost of a Chance. 1962. Stars: Brian Keith, Spike & Hank Gobble. Dave has been promised $50 to deliver a message to a man in a village in Mexico, but when he arrives, the village is deserted.

programme.title: Card from the Cotswolds
programme.desc: 1948. A day in the life of a farmer in the Cotswolds. Watch as he tends to his farm, looks after his animals and spends time in the local area.

programme.title: Sons Of The Sea
